newsitem.title: USA: TeleCheck sees 2-4 pct sales gain during holidays.
newsitem.headline: TeleCheck sees 2-4 pct sales gain during holidays.

text.p: TeleCheck Services Inc said Thursday that same-store sales could gain two to four percent during the holidays, even though the season has five fewer shopping days than last year.
Today TeleCheck reported that same-store retail spending rose 1.2 percent in October, up from the same period last year.

"Despite the moderate October pace, consumer confidence is strong and the employment picture is good. As a result, we expect consumers to increase their spending during the holidays," said TeleCheck's senior economic advisor, William Ford.
